name: Neovici Holding AB ser. B
summary: Neovici, a FinTech firm, specializes in streamlining and automating financial business processes through its advanced AI platform, Cosmoz. This platform expertly manages tasks such as invoicing, order processing, payments, and reporting, significantly reducing manual effort and enhancing operational efficiency for businesses. Headquartered in Stockholm, with additional presences in France, Romania, Ukraine, and Mexico, Neovici provides tailored solutions, drawing on agile methodologies and deep industry expertise. The company processes over a million invoices daily and continues to expand its influence in the financial automation sector.
